judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: The two-track Summary makes separate undirected and directed repairs scannable without pretending one network meaning fits all.
The direct admission of unavailable tie detail makes the graph simplification inspectable.
The factorial-cost trigger gives the sampled Shapley approximation a visible reason instead of a generic efficiency claim.
Reading named rank changes into an added mechanism ties Table 5 to a decision point while retaining the no-ground-truth limit.
The final selected-list damping boundary prevents a broad stability claim from closing the paper without scope.

language_observations.summary: Human style comes from visible missing-data choices, method switches, rank disagreements, repair mechanisms, scoped sensitivity, and concrete limits rather than connective-word density.
summary names the missing property before each replacement: Move from centrality limits through the cohesion-Shapley repair and citation PageRank extension to sensitivity boundaries.

introduction makes an old method inadequate before naming the new one: Specify weight, structure, order, directedness, or external context that the baseline misses, then introduce only the fitting method.
unavailable relation detail becomes an explicit scope cost: Name the unavailable coauthor count or date, choose an unweighted graph, and retain what the simplification cannot represent.
matched network diagnostics lead to a qualified class label: Read degree, path, and clustering evidence against a random comparator before calling the network small-world or scale-free.

a centrality mismatch triggers a cohesion contribution measure: Show why conventional node scores miss the requested contribution, define adjusted cohesion, then allocate marginal effect with Shapley value.
factorial exact cost triggers a sampled approximation: State that all permutations are infeasible, sample k random orders, compare stability, and retain a computation boundary.
a counterintuitive sign is interpreted through metric direction: Explain the cohesion direction, connect a negative Shapley value to a positive contribution, and avoid score-sign inversion.
matched rankings use agreement and disagreement as information: Compare Top-10 or Top-5 lists under the same population, isolate overlap and exception, then bound what the comparison says.
citation-web differences drive a PageRank repair: Start with the web analogy, enumerate static links, sparse citations, and outside references, then add an outside node and weights.
outside-node mass receives a separate observed weighting rule: Construct residual outside-reference mass, then use Times Cited only for the outside row and record its provenance.
rank movement is read as evidence of a model addition: Name a paper that rises, falls, enters, or remains first under the added mechanism, then limit the causal reading.
strengths and limitations precede a bounded application: State a model strength, disclose data or applicability limits, then name only a scrutiny or decision-support use.
parameter sensitivity ends with an operational tradeoff: Vary k or damping, inspect the named rank result, recommend a local setting, and retain runtime or selection boundaries.
a figure or table becomes a bounded next check: Read an exact displayed statistic or rank, state its analytical role, then name the data, comparison, or validation needed next.
an assumption declares the computation it changes: State undirectedness, edge weight, citation direction, or damping premise and tie it to the matrix, distance, or transition it controls.
a local result offers transfer only with remade inputs: Name the coauthor, movie, paper, institution, or country setting, then require a reconstructed population and relation definition before reuse.

title: Influence Measures in Networks
unresolved_questions: The Erdos coauthor graph is made undirected and unweighted because joint-publication count and first-cooperation date are unavailable; the lost tie-strength and temporal information is not bounded empirically.
Authors with Erdos number greater than one are omitted to avoid excessive work, without an inclusion sensitivity or retained exclusion list.
The matched random-network construction, seed, degree preservation, and comparator uncertainty are not specified.
Small-world and scale-free descriptions are inferred from one network and limited displayed diagnostics without fit tests or alternative distributions.
The adjusted-cohesion distance transform and weighted/unweighted cases require careful direction and infinity handling; the source does not supply test cases or code.
The sampled Shapley estimator has no seed, convergence statistic, error interval, or guarantee that k=400 is sufficient beyond this displayed case.
A negative Shapley score is interpreted as positive cohesion contribution because lower cohesion is better, but the sign interpretation is not externally validated as influence.
Top-list overlap between Shapley and betweenness is a descriptive comparison, not validation against an independent influence outcome.
The movie-star graph has only a small chosen population and incompletely documented rating-derived edge weights.
Social, career, business, and diplomatic application claims extend descriptive rankings without intervention, fairness, or outcome evidence.
The base PageRank specification leaves citation orientation, dangling-node redistribution, initialization, convergence norm, and iteration trace incomplete.
Citation links differ from web links in time, direction, sparsity, and noise; the transfer analogy is not validated as an equivalent mechanism.
The virtual outside node's residual allocation can dominate a sparse graph, yet its mass conservation and sensitivity are not demonstrated.
Google Scholar Times Cited values lack a query date, corpus policy, duplicate handling, and cross-field normalization.
Rank shifts in Table 5 have no external ground truth, held-out citation outcome, or decision loss, so they cannot establish optimized accuracy.
Institutional and country transfer claims require new populations, relation semantics, time windows, and validation rather than direct reuse of paper ranks.
Systemic-risk language must not be converted into causal or adversarial target-selection advice; use requires authorization, proportionality, monitoring, and harm controls.
The recommendation k>400 is specific to one sample and ranking display; runtime, sampling variation, and error tolerance remain unreported.
The damping conclusion checks only the selected top five rank order over d=0.05..1 and conflates rank invariance with PageRank-value invariance.
